analysis.title: Environmental Claim Verify Ho Raha Hai
analysis.subtitle: Scientific registries ke against multi-step audit pipeline run ho rahi hai...
analysis.step1Desc: Input se environmental entity parse aur normalize ki gayi.
analysis.step2Desc: Brand aur category context taxonomy se map kiya gaya.
analysis.step3Desc: Corporate sustainability reports aur database se cross-reference kiya gaya.
analysis.step4Desc: EU Ecolabel, FSC, GRS aur ISO 14021 registries query ki gayi.
analysis.step5Desc: Deterministic engine ne independent vs self-reported proof evaluate kiya.
analysis.step6Desc: Transparent verdict aur auditable explanation finalize ho raha hai.

result.deterministicSub: Deterministic verification — zero AI opinion, strictly rules-based evaluation

verdict.desc_VERIFIED: Available reliable public evidence is claim ko sufficiently support karta hai.
verdict.desc_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Is claim ko confidently verify karne ke liye sufficient reliable public evidence available nahi hai.
verdict.desc_POTENTIAL_GREENWASHING: Contradictions, vague language, ya independent certifications ki kami potential greenwashing indicate karti hai.
verdict.explanation_VERIFIED: Available reliable evidence is claim ko sufficiently support karta hai.
verdict.explanation_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Is claim ko confidently verify karne ke liye sufficient reliable public evidence available nahi hai.
verdict.explanation_POTENTIAL_GREENWASHING: Contradictions, vague language, ya independent certifications ki kami potential greenwashing indicate karti hai.
